topics.description: The investigation into the Federal Reserve and its chair Jerome Powell is gaining attention due to the lack of evidence found. This has led to a judge quashing subpoenas in the case. The investigation is ongoing, but the latest developments have raised questions about the validity of the probe.

The investigation into the Feeding Our Future program is ongoing, with multiple defendants indicating they are ready to take plea deals. This suggests that the investigation is making progress and that those involved may be willing to cooperate.
